name: CPU
source: AMD Q2, Intel Q1, Arm Q1 FY2027 + Microsoft Q3 FY2026, Amazon Q2 FY2026, Dell Q1 FY2027
note: Datacenter CPU TAM expansion and the agentic-AI driven CPU:GPU ratio shift; x86 -> custom Arm migration.

tables.title: Server / datacenter CPU TAM
rows: ~$220bn by 2030 (>50% CAGR) — agentic-AI sandbox servers the largest & fastest-growing bucket; AMD server rev +>80% H2-26, +>70% FY27

External estimates now up to ~$220bn; Arm says its March $100bn call 'may have been conservative' but is NOT changing published numbers ($15bn AGI CPU by FY2031 stands); internal targets higher than external

tables.title: CPU:GPU ratio shift (agentic AI)
rows: 'almost in PARITY at this point and could eventually even skew MORE to CPUs on a unit basis'
CPU runs the harness — IO, branch, retries, state; 'in the loop in every decision an agent makes'

tables.title: Custom Arm CPU adoption (x86 -> Arm)
rows: Graviton — 98% of top-1,000 EC2 customers; Graviton5 ramping ~2x faster than G4; post-training RL + agent tool use run on CPUs ('strongest CPU chip, 30-40% better price-perf')
Axion — now a 'core component' of Google's AI infrastructure strategy and THE HOST CPU for its latest TPU AI systems (replaces x86); used as the interface into TPUs
Cobalt 200 — Azure VMs on Neoverse CSS EXPANDED (second gen, succeeds Cobalt 100)

Vera IN PRODUCTION — up to 50% higher CPU perf and 2x energy efficiency vs comparable x86; 'the CPU foundation' for NVIDIA's next-gen AI infrastructure; NVLink Fusion allows mix-and-match with third-party accelerators
Arm AGI CPU (lead partner / co-dev) — agentic-applications category, also general-purpose server
Dragonfly C1000 — announced plans to ENTER the AI datacenter CPU market with an Arm-based part
Cobalt live in ~50% of DC regions (Databricks, Siemens, Snowflake at scale); supply expanding significantly
Large liquid-cooled GPU racks (GB200/B300, Vera) biased to Arm; enterprise B200/B300/RTX systems x86

tables.title: CPU roadmaps
rows: Turin (Zen5) -> Venice (Zen6, 2nm) IN PRODUCTION NOW: >2x perf/W vs x86, 3.3x vs Arm, 30+ SKUs, cloud deploys late 2026 -> Verona with MI500 platform in 2027
Xeon 6 (Intel 3) -> Xeon 6+ (first server product on 18A, launched Q2 2026) -> Diamond Rapids -> Coral Rapids (adds SMT)

AGI CPU 128 cores (per Q1 FY27 call); initial product DELIVERED to multiple customers; supply secured for the $1bn opportunity while demand now EXCEEDS $2bn (new US + China customers); first shipments end-CY2026, silicon breaks out as a third revenue line in FY2028; GM high-30s/low-40s -> 50% over a couple of years; head nodes at OpenAI/Cerebras, agentic apps at Meta/Cloudflare, plus Oracle OCI
